Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's data and deletes duplicate files based on SHA256 hashes for targeted file extensions. Deletes duplicate files instead of decrypting them if SHA256 hash matches.
Indicators of Compromise: Deletion of duplicate files with specific extensions (.txt, .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .sqlite, .odt, .jpg, .jpeg, .bmp, .gif, .png, .csv, .sql, .mdb, .sln, .php, .asp, .aspx, .html, .xml, .psd, .xsd, .cpp, .c, .h, .hpp, .htm, .py, .reg, .rb, .pl, .zip, .rar, .tgz, .key, .jsp, .db, .sqlite3, .sqlitedb, .bat, .bak, .7z, .avi, .fla, .flv, .java, .mpeg, .pem, .wmv, .tar, .tgz, .tiff, .tif)
